default.notes: Single-entry visa on arrival (JOD 40) for a 30-day stay, extendable at a police station for a total of up to 3 months. The fee is waived with a Jordan Pass if you stay at least 3 nights.

groups.notes: Visa-free entry for citizens of Gulf Cooperation Council states and Egypt — stays of up to 3 months are generally granted on arrival.
Prior approval from the Jordanian Ministry of Interior is generally required — apply through a Jordanian embassy or an approved tour operator well before travel.

JO.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Jordanian citizens.

IL.notes: Israeli citizens can obtain a visa on arrival at Amman airport and at the northern and southern land crossings, but not at the King Hussein (Allenby) Bridge — arrange a visa in advance if crossing there.
